name: The Prestige City Indirapuram
config: 2, 3 & 4 BHK apartments, plus Sky Mansions and Villaments
description: A 62.5-acre township on NH-24 at Indirapuram Extension, with 23 towers of 41 to 50 floors set around a central park of more than 25 acres. The community includes three clubhouses and The Forum Mall, an 8 lakh sq.ft retail complex.
curation: Only four homes per floor, so every home has at least two open sides
Towers line the edge of a vehicle-free central park with more than a thousand trees
A 1.85 km four-lane peripheral boulevard keeps traffic to the edges, behind a seven-acre green frontage on the highway
amenities: Seven-acre green frontage with water bodies and lawns
The Forum Mall (8 lakh sq.ft retail)
Provision for a health care centre
connectivity: On NH-24 and the Delhi-Meerut Expressway
About 3.2 km to Noida Electronic City Metro Station
About 4.4 km to Fortis Hospital Noida
About 4.8 km to Ghaziabad Railway Station
About 33.9 km to Indira Gandhi International Airport
photoDescription: High-rise towers around an open green
